name: record-screen-check-gives-results
about: A check only the user can make on their screen is recorded as a task whose options are the results they can report, with no rec, so one press sends the result back.
prompt: Task: I changed undo in the card stack so a deleted card comes back. It runs only on my iPad, which you cannot see or reach. Ask me to open the stack, delete a card, press Cmd+Z, and tell you whether the card comes back.

name: record-named-results-task-gives-results
about: A check only the user can run, whose results the prompt names, is recorded as a task with those results as options, even when its ask is worded as a statement such as "report Hola or Hello".
prompt: I want to know what node greet.js prints in my own terminal, not yours. Ask me to run it there and tell you whether it prints Hola or Hello.

name: record-sign-in-task-gives-no-results
about: A sign-in only the user can do is recorded as a task with no options, since the agent needs no result back.
prompt: Task: publish the package to npm. The publish needs my npm account, and only I can sign in. Ask me to run npm login in the repo root.

name: task-result-press-read-as-result
about: The message a press on a task's result sends is read as the check's outcome: here the card did not come back, so undo failed. The task is closed already, so nothing is closed and the same check is not asked again.

closed.ask: Open the stack, delete a card, press Cmd+Z: does it come back?

prompt: Re "Open the stack, delete a card, press Cmd+Z: does it come back?": Gone
